content: Kilichitu ndi utangatilo gwito
Yana yango iniipala, ninyandikila ilebhe henge, nkoto kuhenga uhakaho. Nambo anda apiti mundo jwatehi uhakaho, tukwete jhumo jwatutangati kutujhope kwa Tate, ndi Yecho Kilichitu jwangalilemwa.
Kilichitu ndi litambiko lilitubhokeya uhakaho gwito, hilu chi uhakaho gwito tugha, nambo uhakaho gwa nnema gwoha.
Anda kuijhokanikiya mihilo jha Chapanga, peniya chakaka kubhehe tummanya.
Mundo akoto kulonge anda ammanya Chapanga, nambo ajhokanikii jhe mihilo jhake, bhahe, umanya mundo jwenio alonge uwange na uchakaka ubhii jhe nkate jhake.
Nhwalo mundo jhojhoha jwakamuu Lilobhe lya Chapanga, jwenio ndi jwakwete upalo ghutimile gwa Chapanga nkate jhake. Kilebhe chenie ndi tuhoto kumanya kubhehe tulombine na Chapanga.
Mundo jhojhoha jwailongela alombine na Chapanga, ipalwa kutama ngita Yecho Kilichitu chatamita.
Lilaghilo liyono
Akakoche bhunimpahile, lilaghilo lende lininyandikila leno chi lilaghilo liyono, nambo lende lilaghilo ndi limikibhanalo kubhoke pukutumbula. Lilaghilo lyenio ndi makacho ndi lela lilobhe linyohine.

Nambo kipinde chenje, lilaghilo lende lininnyandikila leno ndi lilaghilo liyono, uchakaka gwake ubhonekine nkate jha Kilichitu na nkate jhino hele. Nhwalo lubhendo lubhoka na lumule lutumbwii kumulikila.
Mundo jhojhoha jwalonge atama mulumule, nambo inchimwa unung'una mundo, mundo jwenio amela mulubhendo.
Mundo jhojhoha jwampala unung'una mundo abhii mulumule lwenio, kibhii jhe kilebhe chochoha chela nkate jhake chikihoto kuntenda mundo jhonge ahenge uhakaho.
Nambo mundo jwanchimwa unung'una mundo abhii mulubhendo, ityanga mulubhendo na amanyii jhe kwaijhenda, nhwalo lubhendo luntehi abhehe jwangalola.
Ninyandikila mangota akayana nhwalo uhakaho gwino ulekekiwe kupete liina lya Kilichitu.
Ninyandikila mangota akatate nhwalo mummanye jwenio jwakibha kubhoke pakutumbuu. Ninyandikii mangota achikangombo nhwalo munhotwi Jwanganandela.

Ninyandikile mangota akayana nhwalo mu mmanye Tate. Ninyandikile mangota akatate nhwalo mu mmanye jwenio jwakibha kuhumii pakutumbula. Ninyandikile mangota achikangombo nhwalo nkwete makakala, na lilobhe lya Chapanga libhii nkate jhino na munhotwi Jwanganandela.
Mangaupala jhe nnema, hilu mambu ghighabhii mu nnema. Mundo jhojhoha jwaupala nnema, upalo gwa Tate ubhiijhe nkate jhake.
Nhwalo kila kilebhe chikibhii pannema, ngita tama mbajha ya yegha na ilebhe ibhaibhona bhando na kunoghelwa na kuloka kwa nhwalo jha ulohe, yenie yoha ibhokajhe kwa Tate, nambo ibhoke pannema.
Nnema pamonga na ilebhe yake yoha inoghela itenda kupeta, nambo mundo jwahenga ghapala Chapanga, atama machiko ghoha ghangapeta.
Likoko lya Kilichitu
Makayana, kupehekela kubhandikile! Mukajhohine kubhehe jwankana Kilichitu ahika, nambo ngohe akamakoko twe bha Kilichitu bhapitile, kwa gheniya tumanye kubhehe kipinde cha kupekehekeya kubhandikile.

Bhando bheniya bhahumii pakate jhito, nambo bhakibha bhito jhe ndi mana bhakatulekite, anda ngabhabhe bhito, ngabhatamite na twenga. Nambo ngabhatulekita, ngabhajhenda kupala kulangii bhakibha bhito jhe.
Nambo mangota mpakitwe mahuta na Uhuke gwa Chapanga kubhoka kwa Jhola Jwanyahinyahi, yenio umanye uchakaka.
Ninyandikila mangota, chi nhwalo ummanye jhe uchakaka, nambo umanye, kabhele ubhii ng'o uwange ghoghoha ghupatikana uchakaka.
Bho, ghane ndi nhwange? Ndi jhola jwakana kubhehe Yecho chi Kilichitu Nkomboche jwahaghulilwe na Chapanga. Mundo ngita jwenio ndi Likoko nkolongwa jwa Kilichitu, jwenio ndi jwankana Tate na Mwana.
Nhwalo mundo jhojhoha jwankana Mwana, helahela ankana Tate, na mundo jhojhoha jwaumanya Mwana imanya na Tate hele.
Yene, lilobhe lyango limilijhohohine kuhumii makacho litame kumwojho gwino, anda lilobhe lyenio litamite nkate jhino, na mangota natama nkate jha Mwana na Tate.
Na lilaghano lela lyatulaghila Kilichitu jwenio ndi lende: Kutupe ghome machiko ghoha ghangapeta.
Ninnyandikila ilebhe henge kwa nhwalo gwa bhando bhala bhibhapata kunhobhecha mangota.

Na mangota mpakwite mahuta na Uhuke jwa Chapanga kubhoke kwa Kilichitu. Na anda Uhuke atamite nkate jhino, mipalwa jhe kubholwa kabhele na mundo jhojhoha jhola. Nhwalo Uhuke jwenio amolangana kila kilebhe, na mabholo ghake ndi gha uchakaka na chi ghauwange. Bhahe, mughakamulile mabholo gha Uhuke na kujhendele kutama mu kulombana na Kilichitu.
Chakaka, na ngohe akayana ntamengane nkate jhake, kupala kipinde papakuyekulilwa mma nganganga na nkoto kubhehe na hone palonge jhake pala pahika.
Anda umanye kubhehe Kilichitu ihenga ghapala Chapanga, na kwa gheniya mipalwa kumanya kubhehe kila mundo jwahenga ghapala Chapanga ndi mwana jwa Chapanga.
